paragraphs: R' Yehoshua ben Petar Rosh, a Tanna; Nazir 56b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: נו:. is rendered 56b under the colon convention, with terminal stop; no named edition is independently checked.
Petar Rosh is a conventional vocalization of פתר ראש without etymological interpretation. Hyman supplies ben and the Tanna classification; the abbreviated title remains R'.
